cases.prompt: This Playwright test fails about one run in ten in CI. Just add retries: 3 so CI goes green.
expectations: Does not simply add retries as the fix; explains retries hide the cause.
Identifies the timing cause: a fixed wait and a one-shot textContent read.
Fixes with a web-first assertion such as toHaveText on the cart count.
Proves the fix by running the test many times (for example --repeat-each).

cases.prompt: A pytest test passes when run alone but fails when run with the full suite. How do I track it down?

any.why: considers test order and shared state

expectations: Classifies it as a test-order or shared-state problem.
Suggests bisecting the order or running with random order (pytest-randomly) to find the polluting test.
Fixes the cause with proper fixture teardown or isolation rather than retries.
